acceptance_evidence.evidence: process.rs now exhaustively handles the certified ControlEvent and Command variants, performs the synchronous authenticated handshake, and assigns persistent reader and writer tasks exclusive owned socket halves. The strict 512-byte LF-inclusive framing bound and validation remain enforced; the full coop-sidecar plus coop-launcher suite and strict Clippy passed.

The pump uses bounded critical capacity 1, lifecycle capacity 32, critical-event capacity 16, interaction capacity 16, terminal capacity 1, and one latest-state watch slot. Reset publication atomically advances the generation, clears state, latches reset, disables lifecycle, and publishes the notification; post-reset interactions are discarded and presence is excluded from bounded checkpoint/shutdown receive. A durable pending critical slot now preserves a dequeued critical record when reset wins the post-dequeue window, while reset remains first at call entry. Focused control_pump and rom_presence tests passed.

Critical admission and completion use one absolute deadline and sticky ambiguity/closed-lane causes. Lifecycle admission is generation- and permit-fenced under the synchronous writer-admission fence, uses exactly one nonblocking try_write, and treats overflow, closed, partial, WouldBlock, and ambiguous outcomes as terminal without retry or replay. End-to-end critical priority/completion, stale lifecycle, partial-write, and reset-fence regressions passed.

Raw observation and explicit settlement seams are implemented, child observation is biased ahead of control under presence flood, ACK-before-EOF remains deliverable, and wait/settle/startup cleanup paths use one absolute teardown deadline while joining both pump tasks with abort-and-await fallback. Focused shutdown tests and the full launcher/sidecar suite passed.

Executable regressions cover state coalescing, interaction FIFO and seventeenth-item overflow, reset/new-state/duplicate and generation exhaustion, stale interaction and lifecycle discard including post-reset admission, critical priority/completion, partial writes, ACK-before-EOF, child fairness, joined teardown, checkpoint interleaving/reset precedence, sustained-presence shutdown, invalid state validation, and deterministic reset-after-dequeue retention for both receive APIs. The focused control_pump filter passed 16 tests.

All four focused launcher filters passed; the natural coop-sidecar plus coop-launcher suite passed 240 tests with one ignored; strict Clippy reported no issues; cargo fmt --check and git diff --check passed.
